published_circular_speed_source.role: published 3DBarolo circular speeds, dispersions, uncertainties, systemic velocities, and ring radii

compact_halo_comparator.version_path_rule: glafic v2 and AS295 zitrin v2 live under v2/; the other zitrin v1 products live directly in their method directory
compact_halo_comparator.selection_rule: Use glafic v2 as the sole primary compact-halo comparator for every cluster; use the latest already identified zitrin-ltm-gauss release only as a sensitivity analysis. Never choose a method per cluster from its score.

galaxy_circular_speed.interpolation: linear prediction interpolation at every published ring radius inside the frozen prediction support
galaxy_circular_speed.sample: sqrt(mean(per_galaxy_RMSE^2)) with every valid galaxy receiving equal weight
galaxy_circular_speed.uncertainty_diagnostic: also report inverse-variance RMSE, but do not use it for the primary gate
galaxy_circular_speed.systemic_velocity: use the published 3DBarolo systemic velocity as measured redshift metadata; never refit it to a gravity model

galaxy_velocity_field.projection: sample each already locked intrinsic P0708 LOS field at sky pixels using the frozen photometric center, PA, and inclination
galaxy_velocity_field.beam: intensity-weighted Gaussian beam convolution using the target FITS BMAJ and BMIN; no beam parameter is fit
galaxy_velocity_field.mask: finite moment-0, moment-1, and moment-2 pixels with positive moment-0 inside the registered HI support
galaxy_velocity_field.weight: moment0 / max(moment2^2 + (channel_width/2.355)^2, tiny), normalized to unit sum per galaxy

morphology.bins: two pre-outcome bins per coordinate, split at the median of the 13 open baryonic-map values; the exact medians are written into the unlock manifest
morphology.score: equal-galaxy circular-speed RMSE in each bin

cluster.family_split: exact P0633 SHA-256 salted whole-family split
cluster.source_nuisance: one mean source-plane position per family, computed identically for all models; no lens parameter is optimized
cluster.heldout_rule: all selected families were untouched during candidate development; the deterministic family label marks the preregistered 30 percent reporting subset but source position remains an ordinary same-family nuisance
cluster.image_score: global image-plane root RMS after one-to-one minimum-cost assignment between observed images and converged roots within the frozen search field
cluster.topology: exact observed family multiplicity after excluding roots fainter than the compact-halo comparator's faintest matched image for that family; report the threshold dependence
cluster.critical_curve: derive each model's critical curves from its fixed Jacobian; report distances to observed tangential-image loci and pairwise curve distances. If the catalog lacks arc orientation/parity, label the critical-curve gate not independently observable rather than silently substituting a lens-model map as data.
cluster.compact_halo: glafic v2 for every cluster, never selected per cluster

comparators.galaxy_best_frozen_MOND: minimum sample score of the already locked AQUAL and QUMOND predictions; no target refit
comparators.cluster_baryon_only: already locked P0708 baryon-only GR deflection
